Hi Aadil & Maya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have clear roles, evaluation milestones, and a close timeline tied to executive outcomes. I’ve copied Jonas (VP, Product) and Neha (Solutions Lead) to align on technical/POC scope and escalation.

Top-level goals (Q4 outcomes we discussed):
- Goal 1: Deliver production-grade evals across 3 priority flows (search, chat, embeddings) with representative datasets by 12/18.
- Goal 2: Validate cost/latency profile for your 95th percentile path within Redwood Dedicated window by 12/11.
- Goal 3: Finalize procurement and SSO/KMS terms to enable pilot onboarding in Jan.

Proposed MAP milestones (attached):
1) Week of 11/23 — technical kickoff + baseline telemetry setup (REDWOOD infra + Corvina sample data).
2) Week of 11/30 — first eval run + quality review (Neha leads).
3) Week of 12/07 — perf tuning + quantization recommendation (Jonas leads).
4) Week of 12/14 — exec review & signoff; procurement commences.

Escalation and exec alignment (short):
- Corvina exec sponsor: Aadil Khan (we’ll loop your CTO as needed).
- Redwood exec sponsor: Hannah Schmitt (commercial) — primary for timeline/contract decisions.
- Technical escalation: Jonas Weber (VP Product) — for architectural or SLO exceptions.
- Immediate engineering support: eng-ops@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: CORVINA_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood-eval-plan-v1.docx (eval scope), redwood-sla-draft.pdf

Next steps / ask:
- Aadil: confirm primary technical contact at Corvina (CTO or Head of ML) so Jonas can schedule a 30-min sync.
- Maya: confirm procurement timing/PO expectations so we can align procurement milestone in the MAP.
- Team: we’ll move to MAP v2 after we get the CTO contact and procurement cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
